Institute For Wealth Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 12.77% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Institute For Wealth Management Llc sold 8,078 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 55,185 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $9.13M, down from 63,263 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Institute For Wealth Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $953.44 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.35% or $0.67 during the last trading session, reaching $193.98. About 17.33M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 7, 2017 and is uptrending.
